name: Thermoset Roofing Bahamas Ltd

critic.note: Scores are from the first critic pass. Applied its changes in one fix pass: own crew photo in the hero, brighter PBR membrane and stronger sun, callouts moved off the model on dark tags, shorter scroll stage, job file on a membrane-white ground with one dominant photo, white sections alternating with blue. Typography score was judged on the sandbox fallback font (Google Fonts blocked in QA); live page loads Zilla Slab. Not re-scored (pass limit).

history.note: built on rejected rules, rerolled per HANDOFF item 5

brand_truth: The roof over the brands you know: a Bahamian-owned family roofing contractor since 2002, factory certified on Carlisle, Elevate, Englert, Sika, Siplast and Tremco systems.
buyer: Property and facility managers, resort engineering teams, church committees, general contractors and homeowners with leaks in New Providence.

direction.why: Their product is an assembly nobody sees; the object study shows it. Limestone ground with their logo teal; conch-pink render on the building at Balazs's request.

concept_type: brochure: services + client proof + maintenance program + free estimate request

current_site_findings: Two websites are live; thermosetbahamas.com still says South Florida contractor.
Homepage opens with 'Welcome to the pinnacle' and a shopping cart icon.
Client list buried under resort photos that are not Thermoset's own.
WhatsApp promised but no number shown.
Certifications are one red line of text.
pitch_line: Your clients are Baha Mar, Atlantis and the airport, so the site opens with 'The roof over the brands you know' and shows the roof itself going on, layer by layer.
assumptions: Wording for vapour retarder, insulation and cover board is plain trade description, not Thermoset's own text.
Every client on the portfolio page may be named publicly.
Estimate requests go to the General Manager's email.
Photo captions describe what each job photo appears to show; confirm the jobs.
notes: Reroll built with Balazs reviewing the first screen. Manual claim (batch.mjs printed SKIP). Single page (services.html dropped). One pinned WebGL stage: procedural building with ambient occlusion, six scroll chapters, system picker with four finishes. QA BLIND for the 7 hotlinked job photos (Squarespace CDN unreachable from the sandbox): the Work section was judged as grey boxes. look.mjs could not reach reference sites; current site seen via Firecrawl screenshot. qa.mjs 'dead space' warning is the pinned stage in a full-page capture, not real empty page. interact.mjs stalls on the software-rendered canvas and was stopped; the picker click was verified in a manual Playwright run; the estimate form and services tabs were not click-tested. Animation smoothness not seen on a real GPU or phone. Pushed to the session branch only, not main.
